historical_conclusion: M0_001 warm runs reach both goals but fail three original sampled sign checks
physical_vs_acceptance: Smooth bounded acceleration can cross zero between samples; original sign-product policy rejects it. This is not a dynamics discontinuity test.
decision: Retain original acceptance contract and the existing smallest input correction before all validation; do not redefine acceptance to erase M0_001 failures.
ruled_out: reference first-step negative velocity as direct source
state/log velocity discontinuity in the three old intervals
direct state/pose/WAIT reset as the repair
validator relaxation as the reason for success
limitations: sign-product policy is conservative and not equivalent to continuous physical parking
sampled checks do not prove continuous safety
